* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

description:

You will be responsible for tasks such as installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions even when the path forward isn’t clear.

You will engage with clients to analyze their needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications. This opportunity allows you to develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, using critical thinking to break down complex concepts and interpret data to inform insights and recommendations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyzing client needs to implement and support SAP software solutions effectively
* Managing the installation, configuration, and administration of SAP products and technologies

 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 2 years of experience

* At least one of the following: One or more SAP certifications aligned to SAP Technology and platform solutions, including SAP S/4HANA System Administration, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Integration Suite, SAP Security, or related technical architecture credentials
* Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for SAP solutions
* Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori
* Excelling in strategic technology planning and process optimization
* Navigating complex business transformation projects with analytical thinking
* Building meaningful client connections through effective communication and teamwork

title: Principal Applications Dev Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What you get to do in this role:**
 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced IC6\-level engineer to drive the technical direction, architecture, and execution of next\-generation product experiences on the ServiceNow platform. This individual will be a hands\-on technical leader who combines deep full\-stack expertise, strong architectural judgment, AI fluency, and a passion for building scalable, customer\-facing products.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing complex distributed systems, crafting modern UI experiences, mentoring senior engineers, and leveraging AI technologies to deliver differentiated product capabilities.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the design and development of large\-scale product initiatives across the full stack.
* Define technical architecture and engineering standards that improve scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability.
* Drive adoption of AI\-powered capabilities, including LLM\-based experiences, intelligent workflows, copilots, and automation features.
* Partner closely with Product Management, UX, Data Science, and Platform teams to translate business goals into technical solutions.
* Make high\-impact technical decisions and influence engineering strategy across multiple teams.
* Conduct architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical deep dives.
* Mentor senior engineers and raise the overall engineering bar through coaching and technical leadership.
* Own critical production systems and drive operational excellence, observability, security, and reliability.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve developer productivity and product quality.


**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of delivering complex enterprise products.
* Strong expertise in modern front\-end technologies (JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Web Components, modern UI architecture).
* Strong backend engineering experience with distributed systems, APIs, microservices, and cloud\-native architectures.
* Demonstrated ability to design systems that scale to enterprise workloads.
* Experience leading technical initiatives spanning multiple teams without direct authority.
* Deep understanding of software design principles, architecture patterns, performance optimization, and system reliability.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience building products on the ServiceNow platform.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures, AI agents, vector databases, and prompt engineering.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities into customer\-facing enterprise products.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms and modern DevOps practices.
* Experience with analytics, experimentation, telemetry, and data\-driven product development.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* Shapes the technical vision for major product areas.
* Delivers architectures that enable rapid innovation while maintaining quality and scale.
* Drives adoption of AI capabilities that create measurable customer value.
* Raises engineering standards across the organization through technical leadership and mentorship.
* Becomes a trusted technical advisor for both engineering and product leadership.


 Additional Information
   

  

**Work Personas**
 We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.

 ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. **Accommodations**
 We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 The Development family is responsible for creating, designing, deploying, and supporting applications, programs, and software solutions. May include research, new development, prototyping, modification, reuse, re\-engineering, maintenance, or any other activities related to software products used internally or externally on product platforms supported by the firm. The software development process requires in\-depth subject matter expertise in existing and emerging development methodologies, tools, and programming languages. Software Developers work closely with business partners and / or external clients in defining requirements and implementing solutions. The Software Engineering role specializes in planning, documenting technical requirements, designing, developing, and testing all software systems and applications for the firm. Works closely with architects, product managers, project management, and end\-users in the development and enhancement of existing software systems and applications, proposing and recommending solutions that solve complex business problems.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities \- Design, build, and maintain scalable enterprise data pipelines and data products using Snowflake, dbt, Python, and Apache Airflow.
   

  

* Develop and optimize data models following Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) principles to support analytics, reporting, and downstream data consumption.
* Implement and manage Apache Iceberg tables, ensuring efficient data storage, partitioning, lifecycle management, and performance optimization.
* Build and maintain complex Airflow DAGs to orchestrate large\-scale batch and data processing workflows with high reliability and observability.
* Develop advanced SQL transformations and data quality frameworks to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and governance across platforms.
* Optimize Snowflake workloads by monitoring query performance, warehouse sizing, clustering strategies, and credit consumption to improve cost efficiency.
* Collaborate with data architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Develop reusable dbt models, macros, tests, and documentation while promoting data engineering best practices.
* Utilize PySpark for large\-scale data processing and transformation activities where distributed computing is required.
* Implement infrastructure\-as\-code solutions using Terraform to automate provisioning and management of cloud data platform resources.
* Support CI/CD implementation for data engineering solutions using Git\-based workflows, automated testing, and deployment pipelines.
* Leverage Snowflake Cortex and AI\-powered capabilities to enable intelligent data processing, enrichment, and analytical use cases.
* Containerize and deploy data engineering applications using Docker and modern DevOps practices.
* Conduct performance tuning, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis across data pipelines, orchestration workflows, and storage layers.

**Position Summary**
 Tax Technology Services Consultant II
   

  

 Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited supports multiple Deloitte Tax LLP U.S. service lines through technology\-ena bled delivery capabilities in India. In this role, you will support tax transformation initiatives by helping design and implement SAP\-based data and reporting solutions that improve how tax data is sourced, modeled, and consumed.  Work you'll do
   

  

 As a Tax Technology Services Consultant II on the Tax Technology Services team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Designing and implementing semantic data models in SAP Datasphere using business layer and analytical modeling capabilities
* Building and maintaining data pipelines for ingestion, t ransformation, harmonization, and synchronizatio n of data from SAP and non\-SAP source systems
* Creating and optimizing tables, views, transformation s, replication flows, task chains, and SQL\-based views within SAP Datasphere
* Developing Core Data Services (CDS) views for data extraction from SAP S/4HANA and SAP ERP Central Component (ECC) environments
* Collaborating with tax, technology, and broader project stakeholders to align solution design with business requirements and downstream process flows


 The team
   

  

 The Tax Technology Services team helps clients modernize tax operations through technology\-ena bled t ransformation. The team works across tax, data, and enterprise platforms to support scalable solutions that improve reporting, data accessibility, and process efficiency. Professionals in this group collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to deliver solutions that align tax requirements with broader enterprise system design.
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad, Bangalore, Gurgaon

 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

* Experience creating Core Data Services (CDS) views for data extraction from SAP S/4HANA or SAP ERP Central Component (ECC)
* Experience working with replication flows, remote tables, data flows, task chains, and SQL\-based views
* Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP) development environments
* Experience with at least one SAP analytical product or SAP data warehousing product

This role acts as a key contributor between business requirements, Product needs, and engineering execution, translating requirements related to connected assets, equipment health, telemetry data, reliability workflows, and customer\-facing digital experiences into secure, reliable, and production\-ready backend solutions. **Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 We are the Global KYC and Onboarding squad in the Servicing department and we have a mission: to enable teams at Wise to expand and fine\-tune the business in a "config change" manner all across the globe, while remaining compliant and safe for the customers. There are three teams in the squad: Business Onboarding Verification, Personal Onboarding Verification and Wise Platform Verification (our B2B platform).
   

  

 The scale we operate at: In FY2025, 15\.6 million people and businesses used Wise, we onboarded over 5\.9 million new customers (\~500k/month), and moved £145\.2bn across borders (\~£400m/day) across 160\+ countries and 40\+ currencies. Our verification systems aren't supporting tools — they're core production infrastructure that protects customers, enables growth, and must stay reliable under constant change in regulations, policies, and evolving threat patterns.
   

  

 All of the teams are diverse, cross\-functional groups passionate about solving complex problems with elegant solutions. We bring together backend and frontend engineers, mobile developers, designers, data analysts, and product managers who collaborate closely to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Our teams are responsible for the critical verification journeys that business and personal customers complete before using Wise's products. We own the entire verification lifecycle – from document collection flows and automated review systems to agent tooling and compliance monitoring. We operate with high ownership in a bottom\-up, transparent culture, make data\-driven decisions, and celebrate both technical excellence and customer impact. Right now we're focused on building KYC/FinCrime as a configuration\-driven product, refactoring and building new scalable microservice systems, and increasing automation using ML/AI where it genuinely improves decisioning, review quality, and operational efficiency — with safe fallbacks and clear observability. As a team that touches both regulatory requirements and customer experience, we have unique opportunities to innovate in a space traditionally resistant to change.
   

  

 By joining one of our teams, you'll directly impact these customers by transforming a traditionally frustrating experience into one that's fast, intuitive, and fair. Your code will help individuals and small businesses access global banking faster, enable entrepreneurs to pay international employees on time, and allow people like you and your teammates support their families across borders without friction. We're not just building verification systems – we're removing barriers that stand between our customers and their financial freedom.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own large\-sized, impactful projects within the domain. Your responsibilities span end\-to\-end:
   

  

 You will own the technical roadmap for your areas of ownership, ensuring they address important technical debt, reliability, scalability, and security concerns.
   

  

 You will be instrumental in designing and implementing robust backend systems that provide clean APIs and interfaces to hide the internal complexity.
   

  

 You will drive the integration with various risk and mitigation systems to ensure that Wise is compliant.
   

  

 You will take initiative to identify and solve impactful problems both within your team and beyond, contributing to high\-impact cross\-team initiatives.
   

  

**What We Expect From You**
 You have 6\+ years of experience working with Java 8\+, Spring framework, asynchronous message queues (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ), and have architected and built highly scalable microservices.
   

  

 A strong product mindset and a deep passion for both customer experience and regulatory compliance.
   

  

 You will prioritize work with a holistic view of the customer and business impact, making data\-driven decisions to solve complex, ambiguous problems.
   

  

 Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and architectural concepts clearly to diverse audiences, including product managers, designers, and other engineering teams.
   

  

 You demonstrate a commitment to writing clean, testable, maintainable, and highly performant code, and you are a strong advocate for best coding practices and rigorous code reviews.
   

  

 Proven ability to identify and lead the technical delivery of large\-scale, organisationally\-complex projects, adept at anticipating and escalating organizational blockers.
   

  

 Extensive experience working with relational and non\-relational databases, including advanced query optimization, schema design, and data lifecycle management for sensitive information.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

 We are looking for a Principal Engineer who is a force multiplier who shapes technical direction, eliminates ambiguity, and raises the ceiling of what teams believe is possible.
